why.generic: We ordered the {{count}} files by {{strategy}} and numbered them consecutively from episode {{start}}.
why.NUMERIC_SEQUENCE: All {{count}} files start the same way (“{{prefix}}”) and end the same way (“{{suffix}}”): the only thing that changes from one to the next is a number, running from {{first}} to {{last}} with no gaps. That number is the order, so the lowest one is episode {{start}} and it goes on from there.
why.NUMERIC_SEQUENCE_GAPS: All {{count}} files share a prefix and a suffix, and the only thing that changes is a number running from {{first}} to {{last}} — but with gaps. Numeric order is still the only order there is, so we number consecutively from episode {{start}}: if a file is missing, the numbering shifts.
why.EMBEDDED_NUMBER: Every filename carries a number that looks like the episode. We ordered by that number, from {{first}} to {{last}}.
why.FILENAME_ORDER: The names carry no usable number, so we sorted them alphabetically, from “{{first}}” to “{{last}}”, and numbered them consecutively from episode {{start}}.
why.DATE_ORDER: The filenames carry a date. We sorted oldest to newest, from {{first}} to {{last}}: the first one is episode {{start}}.
why.MODIFIED_TIME: The filenames say nothing about episodes, so we sorted by each file's modification time, oldest first, and numbered from episode {{start}}.
why.SINGLE_FILE: There is only one file in the folder, so it is episode {{start}}.

warnings.generic: Check the proposed mapping before importing.
